notes:
{粗|あら} has two main uses: (1) faults or flaws in a person's character or work, and (2) the coarse or rough parts of food ingredients (like fish bones and head used for stock).

COMMON PATTERNS (sense 1 — faults):
- {粗|あら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧: to look for faults
- {粗|あら}⟦{探|さが}し→探す：00493_sagasu⟧: fault-finding, nitpicking
- {粗|あら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧: flaws become visible
- {粗|あら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{目立|めだ}つ→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧: flaws are conspicuous
- {粗|あら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: flaws come out / are exposed

COMMON PATTERNS (sense 2 — rough parts):
- ⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{粗|あら}: fish trimmings (head, bones, etc.)
- {粗|あら}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出汁|だし}→出汁：04917_dashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to make stock from trimmings

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{粗|あら}い→粗い：00439_arai⟧: rough, coarse (i-adjective)
- ⟦{欠点|けってん}→欠点：02702_ketten⟧: fault, shortcoming (more neutral)
- ⟦{粗末|そまつ}→粗末：03323_somatsu⟧: crude, poor quality
